name: axHub account
author: Brett
description: The hub's session and your hub account inside the console: which hub the console belongs to, which session the hub's pages use here (this browser's own or the console's owner sign-in), a tap to each hub page; your name and email, change your password, the browsers signed in as you and signing the others out, through the console's hub-pages relay. Module axHub (the hub's own pages inside the console, folded from apps/axhub-web Nov 20 2026). Only a wall admin's browser may use it; uninstalling it removes only these pages.
